tools.name: search_programs
tools.description: Search Junely’s catalog of Colorado summer camps and after-school programs, checked against each provider’s own page. Filter by child age, month, region, category, price, and open availability. Freshness is per row, not daily: every result starts from its captured extraction date (can be weeks old);

tools.name: get_program_details
tools.description: Full details for a single program by its Junely id (from search results): description, dates, ages, price, current enrollment status, and the provider’s info + registration links.

tools.name: whats_open
tools.description: Programs currently OPEN for registration, most recently updated first — Junely’s honesty signal. Freshness is per row, not a blanket re-check: live_verified means Junely re-checked that program’s own page today for after-school listings; for camps it only reflects the status/dates captured at last e

tools.name: save_camp
tools.description: Saves a program to the signed-in user’s Junely watchlist. NOTE: saving also arms spot-opening/status-change email alerts for that program — identical to tapping ★ on junely.co. Only call when the user explicitly asks to save/track a program. Requires connecting the user’s Junely account.

tools.name: watch_program
tools.description: Sets a fills-up/closing email alert for one program on the signed-in user’s Junely account — identical to the “alert me” button on junely.co. Only call when the user explicitly asks to be alerted. Requires connecting the user’s Junely account.
